name: tensixinet
how: Plays chip telemetry as synthesizer sound; starts its audio worker with gozer run, which leases the chips and resets them on exit.

name: tt-bio-demo
how: Protein-folding demo; its hardware runner wraps each run in gozer run when gozer is installed.

name: tt-discolike
how: Catalog and launcher for Gradio demo apps; shows live chip lease state from gozer status --json.

name: tt-orchard
how: Harness that brings up new models; its lease adapter calls gozer acquire, reset, release and status for each lease.

name: tt-station
how: Mac client and box agent for serving models; the agent runs gozer acquire before it starts a server and releases it after.

name: tt-tnt
how: Llama-like model built for Tenstorrent hardware; its training demo script runs the trainer under gozer run.
